module: Flowgraph node 'Select' (logic category). Chooses a value among N inputs value_i according to the active select_i flow pins, and combines the selected values with a merge function (fg_utils.mergeFuns.any: 'first' mode by default). If the input flow pin is not connected, the value is not kept. The number of choices is set in the properties.
notes: updatePins tests lnk.sourcePin whereas select_i/value_i are input pins (targetPin): the links to the removed pins are therefore not deleted.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Panel: number of choices (Count) and dropdown of merge functions (excluding 'readOnly') with tooltip.

updatePins.desc: Creates or deletes the select_i / value_i pin pairs and the associated links.

work.desc: Initializes the merge, merges the value_i whose select_i is active (if flow), finalizes. If at least one choice: flow=true and value=result; otherwise flow follows the input and value=nil.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reads back mode ('first' by default) and count, recreates the pins.
